Markets.title: Central Bank of India Q2 profit rises 21% as loans grow 30%
Markets.summary: Central Bank of India reported a 21% increase in its September 2026 quarterly net profit to Rs 1,469 crore. This growth was driven by a 30% expansion in loans and an improvement in asset quality, with net NPA declining to 0.31%.

Markets.title: Rising borrowing costs signal funding risks for global AI expansion: Jefferies report
Markets.summary: Rising borrowing costs are creating credit risks and funding struggles for companies expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure, such as Oracle and CoreWeave. Investors should monitor credit spreads to evaluate whether these AI projects can maintain adequate financing.

Markets.title: AI race may depend more on access to power, infrastructure than chip supply: Morgan Stanley
Markets.summary: Morgan Stanley warns that the AI infrastructure market faces a 32-gigawatt electricity shortfall by 2028. This impending power deficit threatens data-center development and could disadvantage smaller enterprises in the AI race.

Markets.title: ixigo Q2 profit at Rs 63 cr on robust show in hotel booking biz
Markets.summary: Ixigo reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 63.42 crore for the September quarter, bouncing back from a net loss of Rs 3.46 crore a year ago. This financial turnaround was driven by strong growth in hotel bookings, resulting in an operational revenue of Rs 320.96 crore.

Markets.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 14,843 crore, NII rises 18%
Markets.summary: ICICI Bank reported a 20.1% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 14,843 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2027. During the same period, the private lender's net interest income (NII) rose by 18%.

Markets.title: IDBI Bank Q2 results: Net profit tanks 39% YoY to Rs 2,205 crore; NII dips 49% YoY
Markets.summary: IDBI Bank reported a 39% year-on-year drop in Q2 net profit to Rs 2,205 crore due to a one-off gain in the previous year. Despite this profit decline, the bank saw improvements in asset quality, deposit growth, and net interest margins.

Geo-Political.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump temporarily waived several recent congressional sanctions against Moscow, citing national security concerns. This decision occurred as his diplomatic dispute with Ukrainian President Zelensky intensified.

Geo-Political.title: Teacher fought US school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
Geo-Political.summary: A 16-year-old former student targeted a special educational needs classroom at a primary school before a teacher fought him. An armed parent then shot the suspect multiple times, according to police.

Geo-Political.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
Geo-Political.summary: Three men were sentenced to 158 years in prison each for the murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend during a surfing trip in Mexico. The victims were killed in April 2024 during what authorities determined was a botched robbery.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
Geo-Political.summary: Amazon deforestation in Brazil dropped to a record low ahead of the upcoming presidential election. This decline reverses the widespread forest destruction that occurred during the administration of former president Jair Bolsonaro.

Geo-Political.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
Geo-Political.summary: A nursery owner in China was sentenced to life in prison after she and five staff members poisoned hundreds of children. They used inedible paint in meals to make the food look more appealing.

Geo-Political.title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
Geo-Political.summary: A rare French royal diamond is being displayed publicly for the first time since it was stolen in 1926. The famous jewel was recovered a century ago after being hidden inside an apple by an amateur thief.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates a shift in generating organic traffic through AI optimization compared to traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape of 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence tools to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top ten AI applications that simplify and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has launched an AI Studio that functions as a generative content platform. The tool allows users to create, share, and monetize AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced AI tools from 2023 that drive efficiency across various industries by automating tasks and improving workflows. These widely used applications are designed to enhance overall productivity.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Jio’s mega debut, deferred UPI charges, IDBI bank stake sale
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly data compilation highlights Reliance Jio's significant market debut, the postponement of UPI charges, and the ongoing stake sale process for IDBI Bank. These insights are presented through easy-to-read charts based on top stories reported by Mint over the past week.

Data & Insights.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga warned that 1.2 billion youth will enter the global workforce over the next decade against only 400 million projected jobs. To address this and other economic challenges, the World Bank plans to increase critical minerals financing to $19 billion through fiscal 2030 while mobilizing more private capital.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, and three other companies will invest to upgrade five ITI clusters under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the cumulative approved investment under the scheme to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The three-day Vibrant Goa summit will take place from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium in Taleigao. The event connects 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will boost productivity over time while potentially increasing short-term inflation through heavy investment. He warned that the economic transition ahead will be bumpy due to technological uncertainty and emerging markets.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics reports that India may moderately raise fuel prices in November ahead of state elections early next year. This potential price hike is expected to push inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

India.title: 13 Women, 1 Child Among 17 Killed In Kolkata Durga Puja Pandal Stampede
India.summary: A stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata resulted in the deaths of 17 people, including 13 women and one child. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed his condolences and announced an interim compensation of Rs 2 lakh for the victims' families.

India.title: Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede: What We Know So Far
India.summary: A stampede during a Durga Puja celebration in Kolkata resulted in multiple deaths. The fatalities include 13 women and a child.

India.title: Rain, Narrow Exit, Weekend Rush: Witnesses Recount Kolkata Puja Pandal Stampede
India.summary: Witnesses reported that a Kolkata Puja pandal stampede was caused by narrow entry and exit gates combined with poor lighting and a weekend rush during rain. The incident resulted in injuries, including the daughter and granddaughter of a local resident.

India.title: Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede Updates: PM Announces Rs 2 Lakh Compensation For Families Of Dead
India.summary: Prime Minister announced Rs 2 lakh in compensation for the families of those who died in the Kolkata Durga Puja stampede. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari, Health Minister Saradwat Mukherjee, and senior officials rushed to the hospital following the incident.

India.title: Journalist Files Police Complaint Against Rahul Gandhi In 'Pushing' Case
India.summary: Journalist Richa Parashar has filed a police complaint against Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. She stated that the incident occurred when she was pushed during a protest on the Supreme Court premises.

India.title: 'Deserves Celebration': Economist On India's Post-Covid Economic Performance
India.summary: An economist praised India's post-COVID economic performance, noting a five-year growth streak exceeding 7 percent. This current growth matches India's previous 2003-2007 run when it gained global attention as a BRIC economy.

General.title: Watch: 'Mood has really shifted' as Paris protesters clash with police
General.summary: Protesters and police clashed at the Place de la République in Paris following weeks of student demonstrations. The BBC reported that the mood at the protest site had significantly shifted.

General.title: More NHS staff sacked over attacks victims' records
General.summary: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust has fired multiple staff members for inappropriately accessing the medical records of attack victims. The Trust is implementing a new security system to better protect patient files.

General.title: UK must protect against Russian 'hybrid attacks', ex-national security adviser says
General.summary: Former UK national security adviser Lord Ricketts has warned the country must better protect itself against Russian hybrid attacks. He stated that increased spending is needed to improve the resilience of critical infrastructure, including energy, transport, air traffic control, and defense sites.

General.title: Scotland 'not like Manchester', Swinney says in dig at PM Burnham
General.summary: Scottish First Minister John Swinney contrasted Scotland with Manchester during his SNP conference speech. He also announced plans to bring Scotland's bus network under public control.

General.title: Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
General.summary: The Pope has been discharged from the hospital following lung cancer surgery. He will deliver the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing in St. Peter's Square on Sunday.

General.title: Not sure what to wear for Halloween? These outfits are set to be the most popular this year
General.summary: Adult Halloween costumes inspired by Freaky Nikki, Dolly Parton, and gargoyles are projected to be the most popular choices this year. These specific outfits are trending as the top costume selections for adults heading into the holiday.
